reviewStatus: Agent-authored before implementation; independent review pending

requirements.text: Classify evaluated frameworks, pinned SDK and project/test inputs without silently upgrading legacy projects. Native analysis requires the pinned net11 toolchain; unsupported scope cannot pass.

Version assessment/decision/evidence protocols. Bind actual source, requirement, configuration, dependency, engine and execution identities. Missing, stale, interrupted or failed evidence never becomes a completed passing run.

Return typed registered investigations, missing context, budget exhaustion or review. Failed original/invalid/incomplete evidence stays local; provider decisions cannot execute commands or grant verification.

Execute bounded exact edits in isolated workspaces with a passing original baseline. Preserve killed/survived/invalid/timeout/cancelled/tool-failure states and all survivors, including equivalent candidates.

Provide reproducible ordinal prioritization from explicit coverage/change/complexity/mutation observations, with reasons and unknown observations retained. Ranking is not a defect probability or verification verdict.

Compare pinned observable API/wire members and allowed outcomes with independently emitted observations. Report removals, incompatible types/requiredness and missing evidence; declare the limited comparison scope.

Use real pinned Polly pipelines with controlled transport and time to record attempts, outcomes, cancellation, timeout, breaker recovery, concurrency and fallback. Validate explicit trace requirements, not inferred global resilience.

Create a standalone pinned functional application scaffold without overwriting files; supply requirements, tests, policy, workflow manifest, registered mutations and coding-agent guidance. Prove a fresh generated application builds and verifies with the same API.

Produce a requirement-bound work item for a coding agent, then assess a candidate with preserved baselines and explicit obligations. Test failures, contract regressions and incomplete runs remain visible; no automatic equivalence exclusion.

Preserve existing engine reports and Decision Assist mutation CLI behavior. Revalidate previous sample gates with the latest engine; keep eShop legacy and CsvHelper historical evidence scoped separately.
